scope: Three bounded ADB invocations against the existing transport; get-state, two non-identifying properties, fixed-path stat and maxdepth2 regular-file metadata listing. No file contents, ECU traffic, service start, loader, ByDLogTool, authorization material or table writes. Separate from the offline native reports.
identityBoundary: These are current properties of the existing connected transport, not a fresh firmware/APK hash qualification or a unique vehicle identifier. No app or firmware behavior was exercised.
limits: Permission denied does not establish whether a private file exists or what it contains.
The listing covers regular files through depth2 under the exact external Scripts path only; internal fallback, deeper paths and other packages are not covered.
A source registration path and current CANFD property do not prove process execution, ownership, table contents or absence on the physical bus.
No protected-file access was retried through a privileged helper. Previous one-session authorizations were not reused.
